create_MLP_module: create a two-layer MLP with GELU activation and configurable hidden features for vision transformer feed-forward networks
build_MLP_with_custom_activation: build an MLP module using a custom activation layer like ReLU or SwiGLU instead of the default GELU
build_MLP_with_dropout: build an MLP with dropout regularization to prevent overfitting in deep vision transformer models
test_MLP_forward_pass: test the MLP forward pass by passing a tensor through fc1, activation, dropout, fc2, and dropout layers
review_Mlp_class: review the Mlp class which implements a standard two-layer feed-forward network with configurable hidden dimensions and activation
